title: What is Art? A Pop Art Unit
description: A high school+ unit exploring Pop Art and color theory through digital collage and poster-making using Photoshop or other photo-editing software.

title: Embracing Matisse - A Unit on Fauvism and Color Theory
description: A six-week unit for grades 4-6, introducing Fauvism through Matisse’s work, focusing on expressive color, shape, and texture in hands-on projects.

title: Paper Mache Masks - A Cultural View
description: Students explore cultural masks from Native American, Mexican, and African traditions, analyzing their significance and creating their own using paper mâché techniques.
